kjv: Let the saints be joyful in glory: let them sing aloud upon their beds.

lines.say: End the day on a good note.

lines.say: Let the saints be joyful in glory: let them sing aloud upon their beds. Psalm one forty nine, verse five.

lines.say: You can go to bed singing, not worrying.

lines.say: Lord, I'm thankful tonight. Let me rest with a song in my heart. In Jesus' name, amen.
